# CTest quarantine for the ThreadSanitizer job (.github/workflows/sanitizers.yml)
#
# One exact CTest test name per line; lines starting with # are comments.
# Each group names the issue that tracks the failure. Remove the lines when
# the issue is fixed. Quarantined tests still run in the non-sanitizer jobs.

# kcenon/thread_system#761: payload races behind the concurrent_queue race;
# the racing accesses are in test code, so tsan.supp cannot match them
stress::lockfree_queue memory safety

# #1256: Catch2 assertions on worker threads (these two also needed the
# #1253 lock-order fix; remove them once #1256 is fixed)
pipeline_coordinator concurrent job submission
pipeline integration - job ID uniqueness

# #1255: rest_server start_async() and stop() race on the Crow app
rest_server async lifecycle

# #1257: OpenJPH's AVX-512 block encoder stores to unaligned stack arrays
# (SIGSEGV on runners whose CPU takes the AVX-512 path)
htj2k_codec lossless 8-bit grayscale round-trip
htj2k_codec lossless 12-bit grayscale round-trip
htj2k_codec lossless 16-bit grayscale round-trip
htj2k_codec lossless 8-bit RGB round-trip
htj2k_codec lossless with RPCL round-trip
htj2k_codec lossy 8-bit grayscale
htj2k_codec lossy 8-bit RGB
htj2k_codec decode sets output parameters correctly
codec_factory::is_available matches what the codecs do
